character.name: Idle
character.prompt:
Create a crisp, high-detail retro pixel art RPG character sprite.
CHARACTER: Young adult male medieval knight with messy brown hair, serious expression, steel-gray plate armor with bronze-gold trim, dark navy clothing, brown leather straps, belts, layered waist armor, armored legs and heavy boots.
PRIMITIVE STRUCTURE: Build the character from simple 3D volumes. Head = sphere, torso = rounded box, arms and legs = cylinders, hands = rounded blocks, feet = wedges. Armor follows the underlying body anatomy.
CAMERA: Fixed low top-down 3/4 perspective, facing directly SOUTH toward the viewer. Head, shoulders, torso, hips and feet aligned along the vertical centerline. No body rotation.
POSE: Neutral upright standing pose. Both arms hang naturally at the sides, equally spaced from the torso. Both legs stand straight, evenly spaced and symmetrical. Hands empty, no weapons or shields.
PROPORTIONS: Compact adult anatomy, balanced head-to-body ratio, natural shoulder width, proportional torso and legs. No exaggerated chibi proportions.
LIGHTING: Consistent upper-left sunlight. Shade primitive body volumes first. Armor and clothing inherit the same lighting. Highlights follow body curvature, with ambient occlusion under the chin, shoulder armor, arms, belt and between legs.
STYLE: Detailed fantasy RPG pixel art, clean chunky pixel clusters, strong dark outlines, limited palette, controlled metallic highlights, sharp pixel edges. No blur, smooth gradients, dithering or excessive texture.
OUTPUT: One full-body character in a neutral symmetrical idle pose, centered, transparent PNG. No weapons, text, floor, scenery or cast shadows. Master reference for future animations
